meta.title: About — tukio.one
meta.description: tukio.one brings together event professionals and people who have something to celebrate. A French marketplace dedicated to local event services.

about.intro: tukio.one brings together event professionals and people who have something to celebrate. No fuss, no lost quotes, no cousin who knows a guy.

why.title: Why tukio.one
why.p1: Organising an event often means ten phone calls, three lost quotes, two unreachable pros and a budget that spirals. We wanted to change that.
why.p2: tukio.one is a French marketplace dedicated to local event services. You'll find tents, marquees, furniture, catering, lighting, entertainment — all in one place, with verified professionals, transparent pricing and secured payments until the event is delivered.

cards.title: Find the right pro
cards.description: Search by category, city and date. Detailed profiles, real photos, verified reviews.

cards.title: Book online
cards.description: No more juggling 5 websites. Multi-vendor baskets, personalised quotes, payment schedules.

cards.title: Protected payment
cards.description: Tukio holds the funds until the end of your event. If something goes wrong, we step in.

cards.title: Seamless communication
cards.description: Integrated messaging with each pro. Full history in one place.

comparison.title: What changes compared to today
comparison.intro: Today, to organise a wedding or a seminar, you go through Yellow Pages, Leboncoin, Google Maps, Instagram and three agencies. Each has their own quote, follow-up, SMS, cheque. The risk, the tracking, the responsibility — it all falls on you.

items: Quotes on PDF, Excel or SMS
Payment by cheque or bank transfer
No protection in case of dispute
One single point of contact per project
Secure Stripe payment, J+1 to the pro
Tukio mediation in case of dispute
Everything in one app, on all your devices

anchored.title: Rooted in Pays de la Loire
anchored.p1: We start where we live. The tukio.one pilot is focused on Loire-Atlantique (44) and Maine-et-Loire (49). This is intentional: we want to personally know our first service providers, understand the ground, adjust with them.
anchored.p2: Brittany and the rest of western France will follow. Other regions will come in time, keeping this local-first approach.

commitments.title: Our commitment
items: No pay-to-rank: visibility is not for sale.
Visible, fixed commission explained at every transaction.
No opaque editorial moderation: public rules, graduated sanctions, right of appeal.
Your data stays in France and is never sold.

meta.title: Privacy policy — tukio.one
meta.description: Your data, plain and simple. tukio.one explains what it does with data collected in the pre-launch phase: waitlist, contact form, GDPR.

privacy.intro: tukio.one is currently a presentation website. This page describes what we do with the only data collected in the pre-launch phase, and anticipates what will apply once the platform opens.

preLaunchBanner.title: In pre-launch phase
preLaunchBanner.body: Today, tukio.one only collects information voluntarily provided via the waitlist registration form: first name, last name, email, profile. No analytics cookies, no advertising pixel, no reselling.

whoCollects.title: 1. Who collects your data today
whoCollects.body: During this preparation phase, data is collected and held by the tukio.one project founder, based in Pays de la Loire. Once the company is officially registered, it will become the data controller. A data protection officer will be appointed at that point.

items.label: Waitlist registration
items.text: first name, last name, email, profile (organiser or pro).

items.label: Contact
items.text: first name, last name, email, subject and message content.

items.label: No other data
items.text: is collected at this stage. No analytics cookies without consent.

whyCollected.title: 3. Why we collect it
whyCollected.body: Solely to notify you when the platform launches and to respond to your questions. Your contact details will never be used for any other communications without your explicit consent. No reselling, ever.

retention.title: 4. How long we keep it
retention.body: Your data is kept until the platform launches, plus a maximum of 12 months. If tukio.one never launches, it will be deleted within a reasonable timeframe. You can request deletion at any time.

postLaunch.title: 5. What will apply after launch
postLaunch.body: Once the platform opens, data collection will extend to what is needed for its operation: identification, payment (via Stripe, without tukio accessing banking data), KYC for pros, messaging, invoices. This page will be updated in detail, and you will be notified.

yourRights.title: 6. Your rights
yourRights.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, object to the processing of your data, or request an export. To exercise these rights, write to contact@tukio.one. Response within 30 days maximum, as required by GDPR.

hosting.title: 7. Hosting and sub-processors in pre-launch
hosting.body: This presentation site is hosted by DigitalOcean LLC (Frankfurt region, Germany). Waitlist emails are processed via Resend (EU region). No other sub-processor has access to your data today.

complaint.title: 8. Complaints
complaint.body: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can contact the ICO (ico.org.uk) or the CNIL (cnil.fr). But please write to us first. We aim to resolve every case within 48 hours.

meta.title: Legal notice — tukio.one
meta.description: tukio.one legal notice: project owner, company in formation (SAS), DigitalOcean Frankfurt hosting, intellectual property.

legal.intro: tukio.one is a project under development. This page will be updated with full legal details (legal form, registration number, registered address, VAT, final hosting) upon official launch.

statusBanner.title: Project status
statusBanner.body: As of today, tukio.one is a project in the preparation phase. The legal structure (SAS) is being registered. No commercial transaction is yet possible on the site, and no personal data is collected outside of the waitlist registration form.

responsible.title: Project owner
responsible.p1: tukio.one is a project run by its founder in an individual capacity, based in Pays de la Loire.
responsible.p2: For any enquiries, write to contact@tukio.one. The full identity of the owner and the future company details will be published upon official registration.

company.title: Company in formation
company.intro: The intended legal structure is a SAS (simplified joint-stock company), to be registered with the Nantes Companies Registry. Upon registration, this page will be updated with:
items: the company name and final legal form
the share capital and company registration number
the SIRET number and VAT registration number
the name of the publication director

hosting.title: Hosting of this presentation site
hosting.p1: This presentation site is hosted by DigitalOcean LLC (101 Avenue of the Americas, 10th Floor, New York, NY 10013, USA, digitalocean.com). The main infrastructure is located in Germany (Frankfurt region).
hosting.p2: The definitive infrastructure of the tukio.one platform (frontend, backend, database) will be specified at launch. Main servers will be located in France or Europe.

nature.title: Current nature of the site
nature.body: The tukio.one website currently accessible is a presentation site. It describes a project under development. It does not allow any commercial transaction, does not store any banking data and does not act as a publisher or host within the meaning of applicable law. Its sole purpose is to communicate about the project and build a list of interested parties for the launch.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: The name tukio, the logo, design, source code and editorial content of this site are the property of the project owner. Any reproduction without consent is prohibited. This property will be transferred to tukio company upon its registration.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any legal enquiry, press contact or information request before launch, write to contact@tukio.one. We respond within 5 business days during the preparation phase.
